note: XXIII fill shots, recipe B, the sky of 3-4 Oct 1893
style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; night in early October 1893, deep shadows, warm lamplight against cold blue darkness, in the dark tone of a gothic Victorian nocturne; figures small or in silhouette, no detailed faces. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: far, exterior, looking in. The asylum at Purfleet at nine in the evening on a moonless night with stars: through a lit dining-room window, a small group seated round a supper table under a lamp; the garden and bare trees in cold blue darkness.
Shot: establishing, far. The gothic asylum at Purfleet on a moonless October evening, only starlight in a clear deep-blue sky, a few windows lit, the lawn black, a stone statue in silhouette.
Shot: wide interior, no faces. An upper corridor of the asylum late at night, a single oil lamp on a table, a mattress laid across the floor before a bedroom door, long shadows.

Shot: establishing, far. The asylum grounds near midnight: a thick waning crescent moon, lit on its left side, about a third of the disc lit just risen low in the east behind bare trees, thin cloud, one upper window lamplit, mist on the lawn.

Shot: very wide. The asylum before dawn: a thick waning crescent moon, lit on its left side, about a third of the disc lit high in the south-eastern sky, the first grey light along the eastern horizon, frost on the lawn, one bedroom window lit.

Shot: very wide, a trance vision in deep blue: the dark river Thames in the hour before dawn, a sailing ship at anchor in mist, a lantern swinging on her deck, the water lapping; only cold blue tones and one small warm light.
Shot: far. A sailing ship weighing anchor in the Pool of London at first light, men at the capstan small on the deck, the chain rising from grey water, wharves and cranes in mist, a pale dawn sky.
